name: Is custom built-in bathroom cabinetry better than freestanding storage?

mainEntity.name: Is custom built-in bathroom cabinetry better than freestanding storage?

acceptedAnswer.text: Custom built-in bathroom storage offers permanent, tailored organization that maximizes awkward wall alcoves, but it requires precise framing, scribing, and higher upfront labor. Freestanding furniture is cheaper, readily available, and easy to move, yet it often wastes vertical space and creates hard-to-clean gaps around plumbing lines. Choosing built-ins gives you a unified, built-to-order appearance that matches surrounding moldings, while freestanding units offer budget flexibility.
acceptedAnswer.description: Custom built-in cabinetry maximizes usable space and seamlessly matches your trim, while freestanding storage costs less upfront but leaves hard-to-clean gaps.
